f11edb6209.q: How does DOJ compliance program guidance address AI governance in both business and compliance functions?
f11edb6209.a: DOJ's compliance program guidance already asks how a company governs AI in both its business and its compliance program, and what baseline of human decision-making it uses to judge the tools. It also asks whether compliance has technology comparable to the business.

e7907ba6b4.q: What are the two tracks in an integrated AI compliance program?
e7907ba6b4.a: Track one uses AI to strengthen compliance in screening, monitoring, third-party diligence, hotline triage, and investigations. Track two governs the risk AI creates, from shadow AI and data leakage to unverified output, bias, and deliberate misuse.

2102ef2ec7.q: Why is AI governance failing in most companies according to current compliance structures?
